persona.label: Opts out mid-conversation
persona.description: Answers a couple of questions, then asks not to be contacted again (no STOP keyword). Agent must end immediately and politely.
persona.behavior: Answer the first two questions normally. Then, before answering the third, change your mind: say something like "actually, I talked to my spouse and we're not doing this. please don't contact me again." Do not use the single word STOP. If the assistant tries to keep you engaged after that, reply "I said don't contact me." Once your opt-out is confirmed, stop replying.

transcript.text: Hi Avery, this is Dana, an automated assistant with Bayview Community Credit Union. Thank you for reaching out about refinancing. Is now a good time for a few quick questions? You can reply STOP at any time to opt out.
Thanks, Avery. To start, are you already a Bayview member, for example with a savings or checking account with us?
Yes, I have checking and savings with you guys.
Thanks for being a member. Your form mentioned a cash-out refinance. Is that right, or are you mainly hoping to lower your rate or payment?

objections.rationale: Borrower opted out ("Please don't contact me again"). Agent honored it immediately with "We won't contact you again about this," did not push, ask questions, or repeat the mention of the spouse (fair_lending: marital status), and closed politely.

judge.naturalness_rationale: Messages are brief, warm, and conversational. Examples: "Thanks for being a member." and the clean, short closing at [6]. The agent referenced the form's cash-out goal naturally at [4] instead of asking cold.
judge.experience_rationale: The borrower's opt-out at [5] was confirmed clearly and respectfully at [6] ("We won't contact you again about this"). There was no friction or pressure, and the experience leaves a good impression of the credit union.

annotations.note: Discloses automated identity ("an automated assistant"), asks permission to proceed, and gives STOP opt-out up front.
Membership question is simple and gives concrete examples ("savings or checking account") without asking for account numbers.
Confirms the goal from the form ("Your form mentioned a cash-out refinance. Is that right") rather than re-asking from scratch.
Honors the opt-out immediately, does not mention the spouse, and asks no further questions or offers.

judge.overall_notes: A clean, compliant short conversation that ended in an opt-out handled exactly right. There were no rule breaks and no pressure, and the tone was natural throughout.
